Subject: Pilot ask — starter credits + short discount window?

Karthik,

Thanks for a great demo today — the retrieval + rerank flow looks promising for our clinical notes use case. We want to move reasonably quickly but have a couple procurement constraints: the security review will take ~3 weeks, and our pilot budget is limited.

Two asks to make the pilot viable on our side:
- A 60-day trial window instead of 30 so our security and infra teams can validate in parallel.
- $25k in starter credits applied to the account, plus a short-term promotional discount (20%) for the first 90 days if we convert to a paid plan within 120 days.

Can Redwood support both a credits + discount combo? If so, we can put together an SOW and push through legal. I attached the expected usage profile and a basic SOW outline.

Emily Jones
Director, Applied ML
Suncrest Labs

Hi Emily — really glad the demo landed. Thanks for sending the deck and usage projection.

Short answer: we can often do a combined credits + promotional discount, but larger discounts tied to conversion need exec sign-off. I’ve looped in Marissa (Head of Sales Ops) and Aditya (Revenue Lead) to review the ask and confirm the right structure.

A few clarifying questions so I can frame this for approval:
- Expected ARR if Suncrest converts after pilot (ballpark annual committed spend).
- Any regulatory/regional needs beyond standard SOC2 (e.g., FedRAMP/PCL)?
- Will Suncrest require Dedicated capacity or private deployment for the pilot? That changes pricing and what we can credit.

If you’re comfortable sharing a ballpark ARR and confirming deployment mode, I’ll escalate with a recommendation. I’ll propose: $25k starter credits + 60-day trial, with a 15–20% promotional discount for first 90 days contingent on a 12-month commit. Aditya — for approval, I’m proposing the discount be timeboxed and coupled to a commitment threshold we can define.

Next step for Suncrest: I can draft the SOW with the proposed structure and send to procurement for sign-off once we have the green light.

Best,

Karthik / Aditya — forwarding the request and the usage file. Quick take: 25k starter credits + 60-day trial is within normal flexibility. The 20% promo for 90 days is material — stateful ask.

Aditya — facts for the approval memo:
- Suggested sweetener: $25k one-time credits applied at pilot start; 60-day pilot.
- Timeboxed discount: 18% for the first 90 days post-activation if customer signs a 12-month commitment >= $180k ARR (or $15k/mo minimum). If commit < $180k ARR, discount tier drops to 10% and credits reduce to $10k.
- Risk: if they churn after 90 days, credits are already consumed; we need a clawback or require prepayment of a portion of the commit to qualify.

Also noting: Suncrest is health-adjacent; confirm they don't require private deployment now — that would alter cost significantly. Karthik, did they say Dedicated?

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwoodai.com <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suncrest — pilot credits + discount request (needs approval)

Thanks — this reads reasonable. Approve conditional concession with the following guardrails (exec sign-off):

1) Approve $25k starter credits + 60-day trial.
2) Approve up to 18% promotional discount for the first 90 days, contingent on a signed 12-month MRC >= $180k ARR. If they commit to 9–12 months but below the threshold, discount limited to 10% and credits down to $10k.
3) Require a mutual action plan and signature on the SOW before credits apply. Credits will be drawn from promotional bucket and recorded against SD-2028-394.
4) Include clawback: if customer cancels within first 3 months of conversion, Redwood reserves the right to invoice pro-rata for used credits beyond a $5k retention.
5) Legal to confirm standard data handling terms; if customer needs private deployment, re-escalate for cost offset.

Karthik — you have approval to offer the structure above. Please confirm with Suncrest and circulate the SOW link. Marissa — loop in billing/legal to capture the clawback and promo accounting.

Aditya Rao
VP Revenue, Redwood Inference
